item.title: Chrome emergency update fixes zero-day exploited in attacks
item.dc:creator: Sample Author
item.description: Google has released an emergency Chrome update to fix a zero-day vulnerability that is being exploited in attacks. Users are advised to update Chrome to version 150.0.7800.45 as soon as possible.

item.title: Acme Security acquires CloudGuard in $2 billion deal
item.dc:creator: Sample Author
item.description: Acme Security announced it will acquire cloud security startup CloudGuard in a deal valued at $2 billion, expected to close next quarter.

item.title: CISA warns of critical flaw in industrial refrigeration controllers
item.dc:creator: Sample Author
item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning about a critical vulnerability in industrial controllers used by food retailers. Administrators should apply the vendor's patch.

item.title: Ransomware gang claims attack on regional hospital network
item.dc:creator: Sample Author
item.description: A ransomware gang has claimed responsibility for an attack on a regional hospital network, listing the organization on its data leak site.

item.title: Fake toll payment texts spread in new phishing wave
item.dc:creator: Sample Author
item.description: A new SMS phishing campaign impersonates toll road operators, telling recipients they owe a small unpaid fee and linking to a fake payment page.

item.title: Old phishing campaign targets streaming subscribers
item.dc:creator: Sample Author
item.description: A phishing campaign is targeting streaming subscribers with fake billing emails. Users should never enter card details from a link in an email.
